comparisons.name: open-light
comparisons.description: A submenu opened from the keyboard (Down, Down, Right), Aqua: the parent row stays highlighted, the submenu's first row is level with it and highlighted. No screenshot shows an open submenu.

pixels.note: parent row, in its left inset: the menu selection (blue menu highlight at 85%) over the menu fill; that the parent stays highlighted while its submenu is open is inferred (spec: submenu, States)
disclosure triangle of the highlighted parent: white, inferred by analogy with highlighted key equivalents (spec: submenu, Colours)
the row above the parent is not highlighted: menu material over the window background, computed from the measured tint
first row of the submenu, highlighted and level with the parent row (spec: Open submenu vertical offset, inferred)

the submenu's 4 pt top padding lies above the parent row's top edge (inferred). The fill is the menu material over the window background darkened by the parent menu's shadow, which falls under the submenu: between #e5e5e5 (shadow at 10%) and #ebebeb (no shadow), computed from the measured tint
second row of the submenu: menu fill, as above
